Name: OST Player
Author: ProfeJavix
Description:
[center][img]https://imgur.com/QO3hCLy.png[/img]﻿﻿
- Provides a UI to choose the game OST track to listen to (default key to open: [i]Insert[/i]).
-[b]Progressive mode[/b] can be activated to load only the tracks already heard in the game (on by default).
-If playing, it can be skipped to the next track (default key:[i] P[/i]) or stop OSTPlayer to hear game's default music (default key:[i] O[/i]).
-[b]Random skip[/b] can be activated to skip available tracks without order (off by default).
-A HUD message will appear to indicate the status of the OSTPlayer.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KY9I9jB.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]﻿Just install the latest version of SMAPI and unzip the file in the Mods folder within the game directory. Tested since SV 1.6.5.


[u]Languages:[/u] English (default), Spanish.

This is the first mod I made for any game, so please let me know of any issues or anything that could be improved at coding. I am a Spanish speaker, so if there are any writing errors, also let me know. 
Here's the [url=https://github.com/ProfeJavix/StardewValleyMods]Source (Github)[/url]﻿ if you want to check it out :).[/center]
